findings.description: The KMS key used for audit trail bucket encryption does not set enable_key_rotation = true, so the key material is never automatically rotated. Long-lived static key material increases the blast radius if the key is ever compromised and weakens cryptographic hygiene for audit log data.

No explicit key policy is defined, so AWS applies the default policy granting the entire account root (and therefore any IAM principal with KMS permissions in the account) full control over the key. For a key protecting audit trail data this creates an overly broad access-control surface and permits potential tampering or decryption of audit logs.
